items.title: Do AI coding agents care about SemVer?
items.summary: We gave AI coding agents the same breaking upgrade twice. Labeled 2.0.0, Claude Sonnet 5.5 checked it in all 10 runs. Labeled 1.4.3, it checked in two and often left the app broken. Nearly 1,000 runs show which agents still read your version numbers, and what a patch label talks
